dimensionsMm.assignmentBasis: DeepCool labels the figures (L x W x H) for the assembled product, so the assignment is quoted, not inferred. This is the installed envelope with fans fitted; the page separately lists a heatsink-only figure of 127x110x157 mm without fans, which is not used here because the with-fan figure is the envelope physical validation needs, matching the with-fan convention already used for cooler.noctua-nh-d15-g2.

notes: Published facts with no cat6 or compat2 field, kept verbatim rather than dropped; all from source.cat6.deepcool.ak620.product. Socket compatibility: Intel 'LGA2066/2011-v3/2011/1700/1200/1151/1150/1155', AMD 'AM5/AM4'. compat2 defines no CoolerCompatSpec and no cooler-socket check, so this list has no compatSpec field to occupy, matching cooler.noctua-nh-d15-g2's handling. Construction: 6 heat pipes, Ø6 mm each; two 120 mm fans, 500-1850 RPM, 68.99 CFM, <=28 dB(A), Fluid Dynamic Bearing. Weight 1456 g. Maximum heat dissipation (TDP rating) '260W'. RAM clearance: 43 mm with both fans installed, 59 mm in single-fan mode -- the same category of fact as the Noctua RAM-clearance note, kept here because cat6 has no field for a cooler's RAM clearance.
